title: Flowing
tagline: Flowing is a generative art  project where users create art using mouse/curosr
description:
Flowing is a generative art  project built on Polygon Mainnet using NFTPort and NFT.Storage. The tech stack is NFT.Port - Minting NFT's on Polygon Mainnet and checking transactions
NFT.Storage - Storing Files and metadata on IPFS using NFT.Storage
Fleek & Netlify - Using Fleek and Netlify for hosting. Used html canvas, javascript and css
how_its_made:
NFT.Port - Minting NFT's on Polygon Mainnet and checking transactions
